notes.title: Update to the SKULL CHAINZ Demo!
notes.content:
Update to the SKULL CHAINZ demo! In addition to tweaks and fixes, the game is now less punishing. 

You now have an extra life - obtaining tarot card upgrades will also heal your skull to full!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971897/0cfd2a4afa420530d2c1e90de154325d3247bc03.gif[/img]
